frequency_question: What proportion of major professional accreditor reviews by federal authorities result in formal revocation within the designated review period?
membership_rule: Includes all federal reviews of recognized national accrediting agencies for professional fields (e.g., law, medicine, engineering, nursing) over the past 50 years where termination or revocation was formally considered or threatened.

validity_reason: Regulatory standards and statutory review processes for national accreditors remain stable across multiple presidential administrations.
